objective: Let members choose and persist one of eight original sports-geometry avatars, with a clear initials default and consistent rendering on their own and public Fanwire surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Test-first across backend and frontend: commit failing tests alone, prove the API contract, persistence, validation, replacement rules, every avatar rendering surface and keyboard selection, then implement without editing tests.

Add nullable profile_avatar_key to User and to the public/me response contracts and PATCH /users/me; allow only court-lines, ball-seams, shot-clock, scoreboard, arc, net-grid, baseline and play-pattern. Null means use the existing username-initial default; invalid values answer 422.
Migration preserves bigint identity and existing user/profile data, adds no unrelated schema change, and rolls back cleanly. No user is assigned a preset by migration.

A PATCH containing a valid profile_avatar_key persists it and clears profile_picture_media_id; a PATCH that attaches an uploaded profile photo clears profile_avatar_key. Omitted fields leave both unchanged, and null profile_avatar_key resets to initials. No media bytes are deleted by selecting a preset.

Render the saved avatar consistently in own/public profile summaries, feed authors, and account search results. Existing uploaded pictures remain rendered when present; with neither picture nor key, the username initial remains the visible, accessible default.

The own-profile settings offer a labelled, keyboard-operable single-choice avatar grid with a visible current selection, preview and Save action. Choosing a preset replaces the uploaded photo when saved; reset-to-initials is an explicit option. A failed save preserves the previous persisted avatar and shows the existing accessible error treatment.

Use eight distinct original code-native SVG/CSS geometric treatments drawn from existing tokens; no logos, crests, uniforms, team-color bars, player likenesses/photos, third-party artwork, external requests or added raster files. Record project authorship in the PR.

Backend remains the owner of the profile contract: users/ service and routes validate and serialize the field; feed/search obtain it through the existing users public-profile interface and do not query users tables directly. Regenerate backend/openapi.json and frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts.

At 320, 360 and 1280 CSS px, the grid reflows without page-level horizontal overflow; each target is at least 24 by 24 CSS px with the primary Save action at least 44 px high, focus is visible, and selection is not conveyed by color alone.

No new dependency, network request for avatar assets, or user-data migration backfill. Include bundle before/after measurements: initial entry growth at most 2 KiB raw/1 KiB gzip, and no output at or above 500,000 raw bytes.

Browser evidence covers default initials, all eight options, save/failure/reset, replacing a current photo, and rendering on own/public profile plus feed and account search at 360 and 1280 in both themes. Use only authorized localhost test accounts; sign out by closing the isolated context and keep credential-free screenshots.

Update wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x01-users.md and wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md; update 0x06-feed.md and 0x07-search.md only if their documented public-profile response contract changes. The context-maintainer role can write each named module file.
